explainEn: The 74th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 added Part IX-A to the Constitution, establishing urban local bodies (municipalities).

qEn: In which biogeographic zone of India is the Great Indian Bustard primarily found in the wild?
qHi: ग्रेट इंडियन बस्टर्ड मुख्य रूप से भारत के किस जैव-भौगोलिक क्षेत्र में जंगली अवस्था में पाया जाता है?
explainEn: The Great Indian Bustard inhabits dry grasslands and semi-arid scrublands, primarily in Rajasthan and parts of western India.

qEn: Who wrote the Sanskrit treatise 'Ashtadhyayi', a foundational text of grammatical analysis?
qHi: व्याकरण विश्लेषण का एक बुनियादी ग्रंथ 'अष्टाध्यायी' नामक संस्कृत ग्रंथ किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: Panini was an ancient Sanskrit philologist and grammarian who formulated the 3,836 rules of Sanskrit morphology in the Ashtadhyayi.

qEn: Which element was discovered in 1868 by Pierre Janssen and Norman Lockyer through spectroscopic analysis of sunlight during a solar eclipse?
qHi: सूर्य ग्रहण के दौरान सूर्य के प्रकाश के स्पेक्ट्रोस्कोपिक विश्लेषण द्वारा 1868 में पियरे जानसेन और नॉर्मन लोकर द्वारा किस तत्व की खोज की गई थी?
explainEn: Helium was first detected as an unknown yellow spectral line signature in sunlight during a solar eclipse in Guntur, India, by Pierre Janssen.

qEn: In classical Indian music, which thaat does Raag Bhairav belong to?
qHi: शास्त्रीय भारतीय संगीत में, राग भैरव किस थाट के अंतर्गत आता है?
explainEn: Raag Bhairav is the chief raga of its own eponymous thaat, characterized by komal rishabh and komal dhaivat.

qEn: Which Indian state has the coastline along the Palk Bay and the Gulf of Mannar?
qHi: किस भारतीय राज्य की तटरेखा पाक खाड़ी और मन्नार की खाड़ी के साथ लगती है?
explainEn: Tamil Nadu is separated from Sri Lanka by the Palk Strait and borders both the Palk Bay and the Gulf of Mannar.

qEn: Who authored the 19th-century socio-religious text 'Gulamgiri', which critiqued the caste system?
qHi: 19वीं सदी का सामाजिक-धार्मिक ग्रंथ 'गुलामगिरी' किसने लिखा था, जिसमें जाति व्यवस्था की आलोचना की गई थी?
explainEn: Jyotirao Phule wrote Gulamgiri in 1873, dedicating it to enslaved people in America who fought against slavery, drawing parallels with the Indian caste system.

qEn: In which Indian state is the classical dance form Bharatanatyam traditionally rooted?
qHi: शास्त्रीय नृत्य शैली भरतनाट्यम पारंपरिक रूप से किस भारतीय राज्य से संबंधित है?
explainEn: Bharatanatyam originated in the temples of Tamil Nadu.
sourceHint: Ministry of Culture, Government of India

qEn: Who wrote the ancient Indian epic Meghaduta?
qHi: प्राचीन भारतीय महाकाव्य मेघदूत की रचना किसने की थी?
explainEn: Meghaduta is a lyric poem written by Kalidasa in classical Sanskrit.

qEn: What was the primary objective of the Rohini satellite series launched by ISRO in the early 1980s?
qHi: 1980 के दशक की शुरुआत में इसरो द्वारा लॉन्च की गई रोहिणी उपग्रह श्रृंखला का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या था?
optsEn: To test the launch vehicle capability (SLV-3)

explainEn: The Rohini series of satellites were primarily intended for evaluating the performance of the Satellite Launch Vehicle (SLV-3) developed by India.

qEn: Which ancient Indian treatise on statecraft and economy discusses the Mandala theory of foreign policy?
qHi: राज्यकला और अर्थशास्त्र पर कौन सा प्राचीन भारतीय ग्रंथ विदेश नीति के मंडल सिद्धांत की चर्चा करता है?
explainEn: Kautilya's Arthashastra outlines the Mandala theory, which elaborates on circles of states surrounding a conqueror in geopolitics and foreign policy.

qEn: Which Indian scientist is credited with the discovery of the scattering of light, for which he received the Nobel Prize in Physics?
qHi: प्रकाश के प्रकीर्णन की खोज का श्रेय किस भारतीय वैज्ञानिक को जाता है, जिसके लिए उन्हें भौतिकी में नोबेल पुरस्कार मिला?
explainEn: Chandrasekhara Venkata Raman discovered the Raman Effect in 1928, earning him the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1930.

qEn: In the context of Indian architecture, what does the term 'Mandapa' refer to?
qHi: भारतीय वास्तुकला के संदर्भ में, 'मंडप' शब्द का तात्पर्य क्या है?
optsEn: The sanctum sanctorum housing the main deity
The gateway tower leading into a temple complex
A pillared outdoor hall or pavilion for public rituals
The curved or pyramidal roof over the main shrine
optsHi: मुख्य देवता को रखने वाला गर्भगृह
मंदिर परिसर में जाने वाला प्रवेश द्वार टॉवर

मुख्य मंदिर के ऊपर वक्र या पिरामिडनुमा छत
explainEn: In Indian temple architecture, a mandapa is a pillared hall or pavilion for public rituals, typically connected to the main shrine.

qEn: Which scheduled language of the Indian Constitution is written in the Ol Chiki script?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान की कौन सी अनुसूचित भाषा ओलचिकी लिपि में लिखी जाती है?

qEn: What is the standard currency of India?

qEn: Who wrote the ancient Indian treatise on statecraft and economic policy known as the Arthashastra?
qHi: राजनीति और आर्थिक नीति पर प्राचीन भारतीय ग्रंथ 'अर्थशास्त्र' की रचना किसने की थी?

qEn: Who discovered penicillin in 1928, marking a major breakthrough in modern medicine?

explainEn: Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin from the fungus Penicillium notatum in 1928.

qEn: Which metal is liquid at standard room temperature and pressure?

explainEn: Mercury is the only metallic element that is liquid under standard conditions for temperature and pressure.

qEn: In which Indian city is the Taj Mahal located?
qHi: ताजमहल किस भारतीय शहर में स्थित है?

qEn: Which Indian state is the largest producer of coffee as of recent agricultural data?

qEn: Which chemical element has the symbol 'Au' on the periodic table?

explainEn: LBW stands for Leg Before Wicket, a dismissal method in cricket.

qEn: On which date is Independence Day celebrated annually in India?
qHi: भारत में प्रतिवर्ष स्वतंत्रता दिवस किस तारीख को मनाया जाता है?
explainEn: India celebrates its Independence Day every year on 15 August, marking its freedom from British rule in 1947.

qEn: Which of these is a Kharif crop in India?
qHi: इनमें से कौन सी भारत में एक खरीफ फसल है?

qEn: In which mountain range is the Zojila Pass located?
qHi: जो जिला दर्रा किस पर्वत श्रृंखला में स्थित है?

qEn: Which classical dance form of India traditionally originates from the district of Palakkad in Kerala?
qHi: भारत का कौन सा शास्त्रीय नृत्य पारंपरिक रूप से केरल के पलक्कड़ जिले से उत्पन्न हुआ है?

qEn: Under the Indian Constitution, which article empowers the Supreme Court to issue writs for the enforcement of Fundamental Rights?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के तहत सर्वोच्च न्यायालय को मौलिक अधिकारों के प्रवर्तन के लिए रिट जारी करने की शक्ति प्राप्त है?
explainEn: Article 32 of the Constitution provides the right to constitutional remedies, allowing the Supreme Court to issue writs.

qEn: Which element, discovered in 1898 by Marie and Pierre Curie, was named after the European continent?
qHi: मैरी और पियरे क्यूरी द्वारा 1898 में खोजे गए किस तत्व का नाम यूरोपीय महाद्वीप के नाम पर रखा गया था?
explainEn: Europium is a chemical element with symbol Eu and atomic number 63, named after the continent of Europe.

qEn: In Carnatic music, how many fundamental Melakarta (parent) ragas are there in the standard classification system?
qHi: कर्नाटक संगीत में, मानक वर्गीकरण प्रणाली के तहत कुल कितने मूल मेलकर्ता (जनक) राग हैं?

qEn: Which Indian state has the coastline along the Arabian Sea known historically and geographically as the Konkan Coast?
qHi: अरब सागर के साथ किस भारतीय राज्य की तटरेखा को ऐतिहासिक और भौगोलिक रूप से कोंकण तट के रूप में जाना जाता है?
